notes: הָאִישׁ הַהוּא carries two article morphemes against the ASV's single written determiner *that*; the demonstrative pronoun s014 licenses it, so both articles go unrepresented (rules 41's limit, 47).
אִיּוֹב is the fronted predicate of the verbless clause אִיּוֹב שְׁמוֹ, so the construction-supplied copula joins it and not the subject שְׁמוֹ (rule 20).
יְרֵא is anarthrous and substantival, so the supplied *one that* joins its own unit and the head stays on the lexeme-bearing *feared* (rule 46).
